info.name: Pathway Analysis Service database download API
Downloads found identifiers for a given analysis and resource

params.name: token
params.description: The token associated with the data to download

params.name: filename
params.description: the file name for the downloaded information

items.docs: The identifiers are filtered by the selected resource. The filename is the one to be suggested in the download window.

info.name: Downloads a list of the not found identifiers

params.name: token
params.description: The token associated with the data to download

params.name: filename
params.description: the file name for the downloaded information

items.docs: Those identifiers from the user sample that are not present up to the current data version. The filename is the one to be suggested in the download window.

info.name: Downloads all hit pathways for a given analysis

params.name: token
params.description: The token associated with the data to download

params.name: filename
params.description: the file name for the downloaded information

items.docs: The results are filtered by the selected resource. The filename is the one to be suggested in the download window.

info.name: Returns the complete result in json format

params.name: token
params.description: The token associated with the data to query

params.name: importableOnly
params.description: Only include resources which can be later imported

items.docs: The results are not filtered by any means. The json file contains the whole stored result based on chosen analysis options and submitted data.

info.name: Returns the complete result in json format (gzipped)

params.name: token
